headline: US Reactor Returns to Space for Mars Mission
captionCards: First US nuclear reactor in space in 60 years
Powering future Mars missions with nuclear energy
instagramCaption:
After a 60-year gap, America is sending a nuclear reactor back into space.
The mission targets Mars.
This marks the first time the US has deployed such technology since the Cold War era.
It enables power for deep-space exploration where solar energy is insufficient.
